mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) indicates inflationary pressures, leading to potential monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which in turn can cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which can stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary cycle, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals growing consumer demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expanding demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong supply-side response to economic growth, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 2% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
